records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: He then has what looks like an emergency Zoom call with Rabbi Wolicki (Rabbi Pesach Wolicki). Now, I want you to bear in mind, this is 4 a.m. in Israel. Rabbi Wolicki (Rabbi Pesach Wolicki) lives in Israel. It's 4 a.m. and he's going to jump on this call with Charlie (Charlie Kirk). And he was just on this chat. verification.notes: Wolicki's own public account and contemporaneous reporting confirm an hour-long Zoom call with Kirk the night before the shooting; reporting also confirms Wolicki was Israel-based and belonged to Kirk's Israel-focused group chat. The characterization as an emergency and the precise 4 a.m./two-hours-later sequence depend on Owens's interpretation of leaked timestamps and were not independently confirmed.
